svg.title: Core native genetic correlations and uncertainty
svg.desc: Two maps show all396 native sleep-by-outcome genetic correlations and their standard errors, with the same12 sleep columns and33 outcome rows. Dots identify161 positives under the frozen396-test BH family, including153 historical primary and8 sensitivity results. Type2 diabetes and melanoma retain historical sensitivity hatching. LDL, HDL and triglycerides carry an intercept warning. These are reproduced marginal estimates; no direct measurement contrast, causal inference or corrected shared-source heterogeneity is shown. The accompanying complete table supplies exact values, marginal95% intervals, source identities and QC.

g.text: Core atlas: native points and uncertainty · frozen 396-test family

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #44515b

g.text: 45 traits · 153 historical primary positives + 8 sensitivity positives · printed-precision reproduction
Dots: BH q < 0.05 within all 396 tests. Hatching: historical sensitivity rows.
† All 36 sleep–lipid pairwise outcome intercepts exceed 1.2; scientific clearance remains unresolved.
Marginal 95% intervals and source/QC details are in the complete numerical table; measurement contrasts are untested.
